messages.author: Réka Varga
messages.text: Lot 9077 sat at 8.9 °C for three hours on the 6th — quarantined, nothing from it goes on a plate. 9084 has dating only to the 22nd; an extension is Camille's call, not ours.

messages.author: Petter Lindgren
messages.text: Analyser 1's Monday AM proficiency panel is protected. If anyone wants an evening run, that is a separate request to me — nothing pre-approved.

messages.author: Ingrid Halvard
messages.text: Data lock is 09:00 Thursday the 21st. Whatever date we give the sponsor has to be real.
